{{short description|German mathematician}}
'''Adolf Schepp''' (1837 – 9 March 1905)<ref name="bams">{{Citation | title=Lieutenant Adolf Schepp |department=Notes| doi=10.1090/S0002-9904-1905-01269-6  | year=1905 | journal=[[Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society]] | issn=0002-9904 | volume=11 | pages=563| doi-access=free }}.</ref> was a [[German people|German]] [[mathematician]] who translated several mathematical works from [[English language|English]] and [[Italian language|Italian]] into [[German language|German]].<ref name="bams"/><ref>{{Citation | last1=Cajori | first1=Florian | author1-link=Florian Cajori | title=A History of Mathematics | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=mGJRjIC9fZgC | publisher=Chelsea | location=New York | isbn=978-0-8284-0203-3 | year=1999|page=458}}.</ref>
